characters.name: The Queen (Mother of the Princes)
characters.prompt: A regal Norwegian woman from the 1400–1850 era, wearing a long velvet gown embroidered with Nordic patterns. She has a gentle but worried expression. Her attire includes a fur-lined cloak to protect from the winter cold, and she carries a sense of sorrow from her choice to trade her sons for a daughter.

characters.name: Snehvid og Rosenrød (The Princess)
characters.prompt: A fair young Norwegian princess with snow-white skin and rose-red cheeks, clad in a traditional bunad-inspired dress from olden Norway, embellished with delicate embroidery. She exudes both innocence and determination, often holding a bundle of shimmering myrdun fibers in her arms.

characters.name: The Troll Witch
characters.prompt: An elderly, hunchbacked woman with wild gray hair, draped in ragged furs and carrying a twisted wooden staff. Her features are sharp, and her eyes gleam with a cunning light, revealing her magical nature from deep in the Norwegian forests.

characters.name: The Twelve Princes / Wild Ducks
characters.prompt: An ensemble of twelve young Norwegian princes dressed in simple but elegant 15th–16th century garments. When transformed, they appear as twelve graceful wild ducks with pristine white and gray feathers. Their facial expressions bear a trace of longing for their human forms.

characters.name: The King (Husband of Snehvid og Rosenrød)
characters.prompt: A tall, stately Norwegian king from the 17th century, in richly decorated regal attire, complete with a fur-trimmed mantle and a golden crown. He has kind but troubled eyes, reflecting his struggles to protect his new queen from his malevolent stepmother.

characters.name: The Evil Stepmother Queen
characters.prompt: A stern older noblewoman adorned in dark, opulent 18th-century Norwegian court fashion, with elaborate lace and stiff collars. Her gaze is severe and full of envy, and she keeps her posture perfectly rigid, reflecting her cold and calculating nature.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a dramatic winter scene in old Norwegian forests during the 1400–1850 era. Show a humble wooden cabin surrounded by snow-laden pines. Inside, create a soft glow where Snehvid og Rosenrød works diligently, spinning myrdun while wearing her traditional bunad dress. The Twelve Princes, depicted as wild ducks, are shown flying above the trees under a dusky sky. Include subtle hints of magic, such as faint sparkles in the air, and capture both the hopeful and sorrowful atmosphere of the tale.
modernMainImagePrompt: Imagine the story unfolding today, set against a snowy Norwegian landscape dotted with modern cabins and electric lights. Snehvid og Rosenrød dons a warm, fashionable winter coat and boots, quietly working with modern spinning equipment while twelve sleek wild ducks soar overhead. The King appears in casual yet authoritative attire, like a contemporary leader, while a cunning older woman lurks, hinting at hidden danger. Emphasize the blend of ancient magic colliding with the modern world.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a friendly, colorful illustration for a 5-year-old. Show Snehvid og Rosenrød in a cozy wooden cottage, happily spinning fluffy white myrdun. Twelve playful ducks, cartoon-like and smiling, fly around a fairy-tale forest. A kind-looking king stands by, and a silly, not-too-scary older woman peeks from behind a tree. Fill the scene with soft, happy colors and simple shapes, focusing on the warmth and wonder of this magical story.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Vis et vakkert, enkelt bilde av en norsk prinsesse foran en liten tømret hytte, midt i en snøkledd skog. Prinsessen spinner myrdun for å lage klær til de tolv brødrene sine, som flyr over henne i form av vildender. Kongen står ved siden av henne med et vennlig smil, mens en eldre kvinne kikker surt fra skogens kant. La himmelen og trærne gi en rolig, norsk vinterstemning.
englishMainImagePrompt: Portray a serene Norwegian winter scene from the olden days. Snehvid og Rosenrød is shown in her traditional attire, gathering soft myrdun near a humble cabin. The twelve wild ducks glide overhead in formation, signifying the bewitched princes. A gentle King observes protectively, while a shadowy figure of an older woman lurks behind snowy pines. Render a soft, ethereal light to capture the tale’s mix of enchantment and Nordic beauty.
